references.text: Both verses mark the transition to a new epoch in God's history by linking Shem's birth to the time after the flood.
Chapter 10 confirms Arpachshad's place in Shem's lineage, providing context for his role as the father of Shem's line in chapter 11.
Chronicles confirms the genealogy from Genesis, emphasizing Arpachshad's central role in God's redemptive history.
Verse 10:21 gives the theological title 'ancestor of Eber,' while 11:10 provides the concrete family history that confirms this.
The verses align the timeline of the flood and the birth of Arpachshad, confirming that Shem was 100 years old two years after the flood.
